achievements.name: First Catch
achievements.detail: Catch a wild Pokémon in the Hisui region.

achievements.name: Survey Corps
achievements.detail: Join the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps in Jubilife Village.

achievements.name: Bench Craft
achievements.detail: Craft a Poké Ball or another item at a crafting bench.

achievements.name: Quell a Noble
achievements.detail: Calm a frenzied noble by fighting it and throwing balms.

achievements.name: Ride Wyrdeer
achievements.detail: Earn a ride on Wyrdeer after calming the noble in the Obsidian Fieldlands.

achievements.name: Every Ride
achievements.detail: Unlock all five ride Pokémon: Wyrdeer, Ursaluna, Basculegion, Sneasler, and Braviary.

achievements.name: Close the Rift
achievements.detail: Win the battle at the Temple of Sinnoh that calms the rift.

achievements.name: Forces of Nature
achievements.detail: Catch Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus.

achievements.name: Seek Arceus
achievements.detail: Catch Arceus at the Temple of Sinnoh after every other non-mythical Pokémon is caught.

achievements.name: Shiny Charm
achievements.detail: Receive the Shiny Charm from Cyllene once Arceus and every non-mythical entry reach research level 10.

achievements.name: Summit Battle
achievements.detail: Win the battle at the temple after the rift has been calmed.
